item.title: Biogen's Tau Alzheimer's Therapy (BIIB080)
item.description:
• Summary: Biogen reported mixed results from a mid-stage study of its antisense oligonucleotide BIIB080 (diranersen) targeting tau in Alzheimer's disease. While the drug did not meet its primary endpoint in the Phase 2 trial, the company plans to advance the program to a pivotal Phase 3 study based on signals of cognitive benefit and biomarker reductions. The decision has prompted cautious optimism among analysts, who see potential in the tau-targeting approach as a complement to amyloid therapies like Leqembi.
  • MoAs: Antisense oligonucleotide that reduces tau protein production
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News, STAT News
